scope: Inventory the local Qwen3.8-27B DFlash2 training environment and derive a staged DSpark2 parameter plan from the actual corpus, prior measured searches, official DeepSpec defaults, and a bounded live B550 smoke run. No DSpark2 model or QAT artifact was trained or claimed.

live_environment.initial_probe: 2026-10-19T15:36:05Z: GPU0 idle with 4 MiB resident; GPU1 idle with the unrelated 5078 MiB embedding replica.
live_environment.final_probe: 2026-10-19T15:54:46Z: both GPUs compute-idle; the embedding service had restarted a 1446 MiB replica on GPU0 and retained 5078 MiB on GPU1. No embedding service was stopped or restarted by this task.

combined_training_corpus.included: legacy 24 prompts plus 103 Fable prompts; the 25-prompt Fable live gate is excluded

corpus_inventory.critical_gap: The captures store target top-64 IDs/values and the greedy token, not full-vocabulary target logits. DeepSpec DSpark requires aligned full-vocab target logits for its TV/L1 term and confidence target, so existing data cannot train the official DSpark loss unchanged.

capture_cost_projection.basis: 248320 vocabulary, BF16 logits, seven positions, current context-length distribution, and retained target context/noise tensors.
capture_cost_projection.boundary: A projection from capture headers and index shapes; no block-7 full-logit capture has run.

official_deepspec_reference.boundary: Official from-scratch training on a much larger generated corpus; these values must not be copied wholesale to the 11,273-cycle local corpus.

full_g3_run.note: Directionally strong offline metrics, but offline prefix accuracy remains a proxy and is not live acceptance.

first_attempt.reason: 127 prompt groups require at least one cycle per group; stratified quota could not satisfy a 64-cycle limit.

bounded_live_smoke.projected_full_corpus_epoch_seconds_befo: about 256 seconds from the measured 512-cycle path
bounded_live_smoke.boundary: The DSpark full-vocabulary TV term and block-7 forward are not included in this timing.

parameter_plan.model_boundary: Qwen3.8-27B is the local training prototype. It is not directly compatible with Qwen3.8-Flash-Next hidden-state extraction: 27B is hidden 5120/64 layers, while Flash-Next is hidden 2560/48 hybrid QSA-GDN-PLE layers.
parameter_plan.student_initialization: Promoted DFlash2 generation-3 full head, not the selector-only rejected lineage.

architecture.confidence_head: scalar sigmoid survival head using hidden plus Markov feature

capture.teacher: Frozen exact Qwen3.8-27B production verifier used by the live gate (calibrated MXFP4 incumbent), with an optional small BF16 quality-control capture kept separate.
capture.corpus: Re-capture the existing 127-prompt combined training split and excluded 25-prompt Fable live gate at block size 7; do not reuse top-64 captures for the TV/confidence objective.
capture.store: Full-vocabulary BF16 target logits, target greedy IDs, target hidden context, draft context/noise inputs, eval masks, prompt IDs, and verifier revisions.

stage_a_new_heads_only.frozen: DFlash2 G3 backbone and existing selector
stage_a_new_heads_only.trained: Markov rank-256 head and scalar confidence head
stage_a_new_heads_only.batching: local batch 1; use effective batch 32 if accumulation is implemented, and scale the LR search rather than copying official batch-512 6e-4 directly

stage_b_joint_finetune.backbone: LoRA over the promoted G3 full head
stage_b_joint_finetune.predecessor: teacher-forced during training; sampled/predicted during inference

arms: one low-LR on-policy error-replay pass after a supervised winner
stage_c_objective_and_on_policy.gate: Only exact parity plus paired live acceptance can promote an arm.

qat_order.first: Select and live-gate a BF16 DSpark2 candidate, then apply the existing deployment PTQ and repeat every gate.
qat_order.true_qat: Only if PTQ loses parity or acceptance, add fake-quant/STE training for deployment-quantized draft linears. Keep norms, target-hidden fusion, Markov codebooks, and confidence head high precision initially.
qat_order.lr_guidance: Begin QAT at 10-20 percent of the winning Stage B LR for one epoch.

promotion_gates: same-day throughput, GPU memory, and occupancy receipt

checks.name: memory-profile
checks.command: 512 stratified cycles with 200 ms GPU sampling

checks.name: official-config-review
checks.command: fetch and compare three DeepSpec Qwen3 DSpark configs

non_claims: No DSpark2 architecture, full-logit capture, QAT trainer, or candidate artifact now exists.
The smoke run still uses the selector objective and existing DFlash2 model; it proves the environment and resource envelope only.
Projected epoch time and block-7 storage are estimates, not measurements.
Official DSpark performance claims are not B550 measurements.
The 25-prompt Fable set remains a live gate, not an out-of-domain generalization test.
Qwen3.8-27B results do not establish Qwen3.8-Flash-Next compatibility.
